actions.name: configure_default_retention_message
actions.description: Set the default retention message the App Store shows for one subscription product in one locale, replacing any default configured before. Only text-based messages, with or without an image, can be defaults, and both the message and its image must be APPROVED. Products without a default in a locale show no retention message there, and the default is also the fallback when your real-time endpoint fails. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

productId.description: Product identifier of the auto-renewable subscription, as created in App Store Connect.

locale.description: App Store locale short code the default message applies to, such as en-US or zh-Hans. The value is case-sensitive.

messageIdentifier.description: Identifier of the APPROVED message to use as the default.

inputSchema.description: The product, locale and message to pair.

productId.description: Product identifier the default applies to.

messageIdentifier.description: Message now configured as the default.

configured.description: Always true once Apple confirmed the configuration.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the default message configuration.

actions.name: configure_retention_realtime_url
actions.description: Register the URL of your Get Retention Message endpoint for the environment of this connection, replacing any URL registered before. Once set, the App Store calls it whenever a subscriber opens the cancellation flow and shows the message you pick. A production URL is accepted only after your endpoint passed the sandbox performance test (Apple answers 403 otherwise). Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

realtimeUrl.description: URL of your Get Retention Message endpoint, reachable by Apple's servers. Use different URLs for sandbox and production.

inputSchema.description: The endpoint URL to register.

environment.description: Environment the URL was registered for, production or sandbox.

configured.description: Always true once Apple confirmed the configuration.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the URL configuration.

actions.name: delete_default_retention_message
actions.description: Remove the default retention message of one subscription product in one locale, so the App Store shows no retention message there. Succeeds even when no default was configured. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

productId.description: Product identifier of the auto-renewable subscription, as created in App Store Connect.

locale.description: App Store locale short code the default message applies to, such as en-US or zh-Hans. The value is case-sensitive.

inputSchema.description: The product and locale whose default to remove.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the removal.

actions.name: delete_retention_image
actions.description: Delete an uploaded retention image. Apple refuses with 403 while a message still references the image, so delete the message first; a missing image answers 404. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

imageIdentifier.description: UUID that identifies the image. You choose it when you upload the image and use it everywhere the image is referenced afterwards.

inputSchema.description: Identifies the image to delete.

deleted.description: Always true once Apple confirmed the deletion.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the deletion.

actions.name: delete_retention_message
actions.description: Delete an uploaded retention message. A missing message answers 404. Stop returning the identifier from your Get Retention Message endpoint first, and delete any image it used afterwards with delete_retention_image. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

inputSchema.description: Identifies the message to delete.

deleted.description: Always true once Apple confirmed the deletion.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the deletion.

actions.name: delete_retention_realtime_url
actions.description: Unregister the Get Retention Message endpoint URL for the environment of this connection. actions.name: send_consumption_information
actions.description: Send consumption information for an in-app purchase after a CONSUMPTION_REQUEST notification, so the App Store can decide on the customer's refund request. Apple expects an answer within 12 hours of the notification. Use this for App Store in-app purchases that do not go through the Advanced Commerce API.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the transaction the refund request is about, taken from the CONSUMPTION_REQUEST notification.

customerConsented.description: Whether the customer consented to share consumption data with Apple. The App Store rejects the request unless this is true, and you are responsible for obtaining that consent.

deliveryStatus.description: Whether your app delivered a working product to the customer, and if not, why.

sampleContentProvided.description: Whether you offered a free sample, a trial, or information about how the content works before the customer bought it.

consumptionPercentage.description: Share of the product the customer consumed, in milliunits, where 100000 is all of it. Send it only for consumable and non-consumable in-app purchases and non-renewing subscriptions: omit it entirely for an auto-renewable subscription, where the App Store calculates it from elapsed time and any value fails the request with HTTP 400 ConsumptionPercentageAutoRenewableSubscriptionError. Must be 0 when deliveryStatus is not DELIVERED, and greater than 0 and less than 100000 when refundPreference is GRANT_PRORATED.

refundPreference.description: Whether you would like the App Store to grant the refund. All three values apply to every product type; GRANT_PRORATED only changes what consumptionPercentage must be, which the consumptionPercentage field describes. The App Store makes the final decision either way.

inputSchema.description: Consumption information for one in-app purchase under refund review.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the transaction the information was sent for.

submitted.description: Always true once the App Store accepted the consumption information.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation that the App Store accepted the consumption information.

actions.name: upload_retention_image
actions.description: Upload a PNG image for retention messages, either a FULL_SIZE image shown above the message body or a BULLET_POINT icon. The image starts in the PENDING state and Apple reviews it before it can be displayed; check the state with get_retention_image_list. Each app can hold up to 2000 images and an identifier can be uploaded only once. Only images and messages in the APPROVED state are shown to customers; the sandbox approves uploads immediately. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

imageIdentifier.description: UUID that identifies the image. You choose it when you upload the image and use it everywhere the image is referenced afterwards.

imageSize.description: Which slot the image is for. FULL_SIZE images must be 3840 pixels wide and 160 to 2160 pixels tall; BULLET_POINT images must be 1024 by 1024 pixels. Defaults to FULL_SIZE.

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: A PNG file previously uploaded to the local transit file API, up to 20 MB.

inputSchema.description: The PNG image to upload and the identifier to file it under.

imageIdentifier.description: Identifier the image was filed under.

imageSize.description: Slot the image was uploaded for.

byteLength.description: Number of PNG bytes sent to Apple.

uploaded.description: Always true once Apple accepted the upload.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the upload. The image is PENDING until Apple approves it.

actions.name: upload_retention_message
actions.description: Upload the text of a retention message: a header, a body, optionally a full-size image and bullet points with icons. The message starts in the PENDING state and Apple reviews it; check the state with get_retention_message_list. Leave out image and bulletPoints for messages you will use as switch-plan or promotional-offer messages. Each app can hold up to 2000 messages and an identifier can be uploaded only once. Only images and messages in the APPROVED state are shown to customers; the sandbox approves uploads immediately. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

messageIdentifier.description: UUID that identifies the message. You choose it when you upload the message and use it everywhere the message is referenced afterwards.

header.description: Header text, up to 66 characters. Shown above the body, or above the image when headerPosition is ABOVE_IMAGE.

imageIdentifier.description: UUID that identifies the image. You choose it when you upload the image and use it everywhere the image is referenced afterwards.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, up to 150 characters.

image.description: Full-size image to show with the message. Omit it for messages you plan to use as switch-plan or promotional-offer messages, which cannot carry an image.

text.description: Text of the bullet point, up to 66 characters.

imageIdentifier.description: Identifier of a BULLET_POINT sized image (1024 by 1024 pixels) to use as the icon of this bullet point.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, up to 150 characters.

items.description: One bullet point with its icon.

bulletPoints.description: Bullet points to list under the body, each with a BULLET_POINT sized icon. Apple limits how many a message can carry.

headerPosition.description: Where the header goes: ABOVE_BODY (the default) or ABOVE_IMAGE, which requires an image.

inputSchema.description: The message text and the identifier to file it under.

messageIdentifier.description: Identifier the message was filed under.

uploaded.description: Always true once Apple accepted the upload.

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of the upload. The message is PENDING until Apple approves it.
